aliases: Multi-sensor SolidEDGE powered by NVIDIA Jetson Platform
4 Channel AI, IR and PTRZ Multi-directional Camera

storage.notes: 2 microSD/SDHC/SDXC slots (512GB each, 1TB total) plus 4TB (2 x 2TB NVMe) SSD with embedded Wisenet WAVE VMS server.

features: 4-channel 8MP multi-directional, PTRZ remote lens adjustment (pan 0-360 / tilt 30-90 / rotate 0-90)
AI object detection: person, face, vehicle, license plate; BestShot; virtual line/area analytics
NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 8GB carrier board
Audio and extra alarm I/O via optional SPM-4210 I/O box
SolidEDGE: Wisenet WAVE VMS server embedded, records up to 16 video streams
4TB SSD (2 x 2TB NVMe) included, 1x WAVE Professional recording license, WAVE AI plugin pre-installed

frigate.notes: Hanwha profiles: profile1=MJPEG, profile2=main, profile3=sub (default Wisenet profile layout); not yet verified on this model.

release_notes: Specs per official Hanwha Vision datasheet (DataSheet_PNM-C32084RQZ-8XE4T-W_260101_EN.pdf). SolidEDGE (embedded WAVE VMS + 4TB SSD) version of the PNM-C32084RQZ-8XE hardware. B/W min. illumination is 0 lux (IR LED on) and is not recorded. Power consumption is the max for the included Orin NX 8GB module (66W; 71W with Orin NX 16GB).
